column1: # RAWmakase's colour grading curves (MIT), as text, for Lightroom's colour grading (rm_color_grade.rs).
# Generated by scripts/rawmakase-grade-curves.mjs: never edit a row by hand.
# Camera Raw 18.7's own renders of a colour chart under about 740 colour grading
# settings, measured by RAWmakase (docs/color-mixer.md, "Color grading"). Grading
# is a gain curve per channel of linear ProPhoto RGB, sampled at 64 points of
# x^(1/2.2). Each row: what was measured, the region, two settings ("-" where
# none), then its values, in the order RAWmakase's color_grade_curves.bin holds them.
#   profile     where a region's tint sits along the channel at one Blending and Balance:
#               64 samples x 2 terms (Global: 3 terms, and Blending and Balance do not move it)
#   tint        the region's per-channel coefficients at one hue and saturation: 3 channels x 3 terms
#   luminance   the Luminance slider's gain at one position, Blending 50 and Balance 0: 64 samples
